entities.summary: The Anonymus Cyzicenus is the anonymous author of an ecclesiastical history of the 5th century. It has often been misattributed to Gelasius of Cyzicus, an error going back to Photius and followed by the editor of the editio princeps. The anonymous author never mentions his name.
